name: Twilit Dawn
author: Eyas (Twilit Essentials by Fimmel, Dawnlight by BeZide)
description: Twilit Essentials, Dawnlight and A Link Between Twilight in one mod, with one settings window. Features more than one of them has are a single choice, so they never run twice. Built from Twilit Essentials v2.1.1, Dawnlight v3.5.4 and A Link Between Twilight v0.2.9.
